scan_metadata.scan_scope: packages/ directory (excluding test assets and browser patches)
scan_metadata.notes: Flags are environment variables acting as feature gates in the Playwright source code. PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_* and PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_* configuration env vars were excluded as they are standard documented config options, not feature flags. PWTEST_* config values (PWTEST_CACHE_DIR, PWTEST_PROFILE_DIR, PWTEST_FORCE_EXIT_TIMEOUT, PWTEST_BOT_NAME, PWTEST_SHARD_WEIGHTS) and path/string configs (PW_TMPDIR_FOR_TEST, PW_LANG_NAME_VERSION, PLAYWRIGHT_DAEMON_*) were excluded as they are pure configuration values, not boolean feature gates.
